events.description: Explore recreated Jane Addams Homes apartments that normally require a guided tour, plus oral-history listening stations and architectural artifacts. Saturday adds a 2 PM conversation with the architects.

events.title: Open House Chicago: Murphy Auditorium
events.venue: Murphy Auditorium at the Driehaus Museum
events.address: 50 E Erie St, Chicago, IL 60611; follow museum signs to Murphy Auditorium
events.priceLabel: Free; no reservation required; exhibition galleries excluded
events.description: See the landmark auditorium’s Tiffany bronze doors and stained glass. Saturday includes a free Hanna DiLorenzo performance from 1–2 PM. This open house does not include the museum’s exhibition galleries.

events.title: Open House Chicago: Symphony Center
events.description: Take a self-guided look inside Daniel Burnham’s Orchestra Hall and additional Symphony Center spaces. Volunteer guides explain the building as visitors follow a station-by-station route.

events.title: Loop Arts Fest
events.venue: State Street, Jackson Boulevard to Madison Street
events.address: State St between Jackson Blvd and Madison St, Chicago, IL
events.description: State Street becomes an arts block party with two performance stages, local makers and dance. Highlights include salsa and cumbia from Carpacho y Su Super Combo and a 5 PM headline set by Simone Green.

events.title: Off Book: Tour de Force (A Force of Tour)
events.description: Zach Reino and Jessica McKenna bring their improvised musical comedy to the Vic. The touring show offers a playful Friday-night alternative to a conventional scripted musical.

events.title: Hey, Nothing: The Hound Tour
events.description: Hey, Nothing brings The Hound Tour to Bottom Lounge, with Crisis Crew supporting. The promoter lists an all-ages show; check its ticket link for remaining inventory.

events.title: Rapsody at Park West
events.description: The North Carolina rapper brings her detailed storytelling and lyrical craft to an intimate Sunday-night show. Park West’s age limit for this performance is eighteen and over.

events.title: Lenny Pearce: Toddler Rave World Tour
events.priceLabel: Check source; ages 2 and under free with ticketed guardian
events.description: An early-afternoon dance party designed around Lenny Pearce’s Toddler Rave tour. Children two and under can attend without a ticket when accompanied by a ticketed parent or guardian.

events.title: Trio de Chat Noirs: free noonday concert
events.address: 126 E Chestnut St, Chicago, IL 60611; sanctuary entrance on Michigan Ave
events.description: Take a lunchtime music break with trombone, horn and organ in Fourth Church’s sanctuary. The Friday noonday series is free; use the Michigan Avenue entrance.

events.title: Camerata Chicago: A Midsummer Night’s Dream
events.description: Mendelssohn and Shakespeare meet in a family-friendly narrated concert led by Drostan Hall. The program also includes Mozart’s wind Sinfonia Concertante and a Tony Payne world premiere.

events.title: Chicago International Film Festival: Black Perspectives Shorts
events.description: A ninety-three-minute international shorts program explores family, migration, grief and belief through drama, comedy and animation. This Friday screening takes place in the Film Center’s Screen 2.

events.title: Chicago International Film Festival: Black Perspectives Shorts
events.description: Catch the Black Perspectives shorts program on the South Side. Six films range from a Montreal jazz story to colorful family animation, with a combined runtime of ninety-three minutes.

events.title: Chicago International Film Festival: Tender Loving Care
events.priceLabel: Check source; 11:00 AM discussion free; film ticket separate
events.description: Mike Leigh’s new drama follows friendship, family and the pressures of social care. A free Nick Davis discussion precedes the screening; the film itself is separately ticketed and does not accept festival passes.
events.time: 12:30 PM; optional free film discussion 11:00 AM

events.title: Chicago International Film Festival: Being Heumann
events.description: Siân Heder’s drama portrays Judy Heumann and the disability-rights activists who occupied federal offices in 1977. The Sunday screening is open-captioned and runs 127 minutes.

events.title: Creepy Cruise on the Chicago River
events.address: 112 E Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60601; river-level dock
events.description: Cruise the river after dark while a guide shares Chicago ghost lore, strange sightings and mob stories. Reserve a departure time and bring a warm layer for the open deck.
events.time: Check source for departure times; 90-minute cruise

events.title: Chicago Bulls vs. Minnesota Timberwolves: preseason
events.description: See the Bulls tune up for the season against Minnesota. This is a preseason game; use the venue’s ticket link for current seats and allow time for arena entry.

events.title: Vintage on the Avenue
events.venue: The Shops at North Bridge, Michigan Avenue Atrium
events.description: Browse a three-day pop-up of local vintage sellers offering clothing, jewelry, designer bags and accessories. The lineup includes Wini & I, Hello Good Buys and Shytowngirl Vintage.

events.title: Branford Marsalis & Dianne Reeves Celebrate John Coltrane
events.description: The Branford Marsalis Quartet and Dianne Reeves mark Coltrane’s centennial with a program revisiting his celebrated collaboration with Johnny Hartman. The concert lasts about ninety minutes.

events.title: Red Line Jazz Festival
events.venue: Harris Theater for Music and Dance
events.description: Fareed Haque curates a finale to the Red Line Jazz Project, blending jazz, dance and global influences. Performers include Butter Chicken Brass Band, Chicago Immigrant Orchestra members and Mandala Dance Ensemble.
events.sourceName: Harris Theater / Mandala South Asian Performing Arts

events.title: Campfire Horrors: Hocus Pocus
events.description: Watch the Sanderson sisters return in a free outdoor screening of the 1993 Halloween comedy. Closed captions are provided; dress for a chilly evening and arrive before dusk.

events.title: Fall Festival at North Park Village Nature Center
events.description: Walk the autumn trails, make a scarecrow and try children’s art activities at this long-running nature-center celebration. No registration is needed; use designated public parking rather than apartment lots.

events.title: Trunk or Treat at Shabbona Park
events.description: Children can wear costumes and collect candy from decorated cars outside the fieldhouse. The seventh annual neighborhood gathering also offers games and arts-and-crafts activities.

events.title: Campfire Horrors: A Nightmare on Elm Street
events.age: R-rated film; check suitability for younger viewers
events.description: Freddy Krueger haunts the outdoor screen in the 1984 horror classic. The free screening has closed captions; its R rating makes this a better fit for older viewers.

events.title: Trunk or Treat at Jane Addams Park
events.description: A neighborhood Halloween afternoon lets children and families collect candy from decorated cars. Use the park’s registration link to check youth registration details before attending.

events.title: Black Poetry Day Readings & Reflections
events.address: 180 N Michigan Ave, 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60601
events.priceLabel: Free; includes museum exhibits; RSVP requested
events.description: Chicago poets from the Guild Literary Complex read favorite works by Black poets, with Faylita Hicks hosting. Free program admission also includes the museum’s exhibitions; RSVP to reserve a place.

events.title: American Writers Museum: monthly free day
events.address: 180 N Michigan Ave, 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60601
events.description: Explore the museum’s interactive writing exhibits and American Prophets special exhibition without an admission charge. Families can join Little Squirrels Storytime at 11:30 AM.
